tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model created a deprecated middleware.ts file instead of the required proxy.ts file for Next.js 16+. The eval explicitly tests that a proxy file should be created, not middleware, and the build output warned about the deprecation, but the model ignored this requirement.

confirmations.failureReason: The model created middleware.ts with working code, but the eval requires proxy.ts (Next.js 16+ convention). The agent chose to use the deprecated middleware convention instead of migrating to the new proxy convention, causing both eval tests to fail.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model implemented Partial Pre-rendering incorrectly. It wrapped all data-driven sections in a single Suspense boundary (with a shared fallback), rather than giving each section its own independent Suspense boundary. This prevents the sections from suspending independently, collapsing the shell back to the original all-or-nothing loading behavior.

confirmations.failureReason: The model implemented a partial pre-rendering solution with Suspense, but wrapped all three data-driven sections under a single Suspense boundary instead of giving each section independent boundaries. The test requires sections to suspend independently, not collapse into one all-or-nothing loading state.

The agent generated code that wraps CardStats, RevenueChart, and LatestInvoices in a single Suspense boundary, causing them to load together. The test requires each section to suspend independently with separate Suspense boundaries.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model generated View Transition components using `enter="none"` and `exit="none"` attributes, but the test expects a `default="none"` prop to prevent unintended animations. The code compiles successfully but fails the specific test requirement for the `default` prop.

confirmations.failureReason: The model wrote code to implement view transitions but used incorrect attributes and props. It used `ViewTransition` components with `enter`, `exit`, `share`, and `name` props instead of using the `transitionTypes` prop on Link components as required by tests, and it failed to implement the `default="none"` attribute pattern for preventing unintended animations.

confirmations.failureReason: The agent successfully built a working book tracker app but failed the eval requirement to use Next.js. The model created a plain Node.js server application instead of using Next.js. The eval test requires the genuine Next.js CLI (next in package.json and node_modules/next), but the model implemented a custom server that uses node server.js directly, violating the core requirement.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model generated incomplete code. It added prefetch={true} to the Links but failed to enable partialPrefetching in next.config.ts and add use cache directives to cache the category data, which are required for the prefetch to work correctly with selected category products.

confirmations.failureReason: The model attempted to implement the prefetch URL data feature but only partially completed it. While it correctly added `prefetch={true}` to the category links in app/page.tsx, it failed to: (1) add `use cache` directives to cache the category data, (2) enable Partial Prefetching in next.config.ts, and (3) properly structure the cache scope around the product fetching logic. The EVAL tests show 3 failures: missing Partial Prefetching configuration, missing `use cache` scope, and incomplete per-link prefetch of category data.

confirmations.failureReason: The model wrote a client component with 'use client' directive and useEffect-based data fetching, but the test required an async server component without 'use client'. The model correctly implemented parallel fetching with Promise.all, but violated the server component requirement.

The model implemented Dashboard as a client component with 'use client' directive and useEffect hooks, when the test requires it to be an async server component without 'use client'. The component needs to use parallel server-side Promise.all() fetching, not client-side useEffect-based data fetching.
